record.where: Losing a crate · Controls · Balance (the session bot) · Verification — the v3 loop rules, named by their subjects

clauses.text: An order's crate can leave your back: a stumble drops it, a wraith snags it, scrapper runners haul drops to their stash, a companion carries it, you lock it in storage.
The Guide reads where it went ("Medicine is on the ground — go back for it", "hangs at a snag", "Scrappers took Rations to Pass Camp — their stash holds it") and points there
the compass keeps a crate mark that never declutters
the tray card turns rust and says where
Fix: the lost-crate Guide, compass mark, tray line and give-up (above).
Any order can be given up (✕ on its tray card): its crates become lost cargo for the same place (half credit if they ever arrive) and a ★ order returns to its board.

figure.note: the Mill's star meter takes half of what the walker is paid (rounded), the walker paid in full

clauses.text: A companion's load delivers with you (handed over at the terminal).
Fix: thriving needs are not posted.
now the wire closing a shortage exempts it from star loss
If feet stop advancing or six seconds of walking go nowhere, the ground ahead is marked impassable

figure.note: the check walks the feet that stop advancing; the six seconds of walking that go nowhere are not tried

clauses.text: the route re-plans (up to three times) before an honest "The ground stops you here"

figure.note: with a grid that keeps offering its first plan the walk re-plans exactly three times, then stops
